keyFindings.description: The row above md now renders `<host> · <last path segment>`, so eight locators in two untouched specs that match a row by its whole directory text resolve to nothing. Read on GitHub, not inferred: Legion Envoy and Contracts run 40148254772, job dispatch, at b790a592c539 — 10 failed / 1434 passed (42.2m); keyboard-agents-pin.e2e.ts:173, :223, :272, :322, :361, :396, :542 under [chromium] and keyboard-agents-picker.e2e.ts:835 under [chromium], [webkit] and [firefox], each a 30 s locator timeout. The before-leg run 40143159250 at 4a134cac6ddb failed three rows and none of these, so the change caused them. The implementer's and the tester's page proof were both scoped with -g "an agent row shows the whole session name", which is why neither saw it. Fix: point those locators at [data-agent-dir], the hook this change added, or at the text the row now shows.

Every user prompt in every Claude Code session now pays the load of an 811,698-byte bundle to write one small file, and Claude Code blocks the prompt on the hook. Measured in this pod at the reviewed head: `bun dist/session-hook.js session-title` 166/185/179 ms against 65/66/65 ms for a bare bun script. The three modes share one ESM entrypoint, so zod, the Dispatch client and session-settings are evaluated whatever argv[2] says; the title mode needs node:fs and a JSON.parse. Fix: one more line in BUNDLE_ENTRYPOINTS and one args change in hooks.json.

pruneStaleSessionTitles rethrows every readdir error but ENOENT, and startChannelSession awaits it unguarded before the heartbeat timer is installed, so an unreadable ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/titles stops the channel server from starting in service of a cosmetic title. Everything else on this path degrades instead (readChosenTitleSync swallows every error, the hook always exits 0). The file's own pattern for best-effort startup work is at envoy-channel-server.ts:799-803.

States a behaviour the code does not have: a name that is "more than one line" does not fall back — oneLine (src/session-title.ts:60) collapses the newline and the joined name is used, which tests/session-title.test.ts pins and the tester's own probe reported. Drop the clause.

One breakpoint stated twice and pinned by nothing: PHONE_VIEWPORT_QUERY is (max-width: 767px) while the same element's md: classes switch at 768 px. In the 1-pixel band between them (browser zoom, a fractional device-pixel ratio) the row takes the laptop's string in the phone's layout. Cosmetic — the whole path stays in the title attribute — but the two must agree for ever and nothing makes them.

encodeURIComponent does not escape a dot, and the title file takes no suffix, so a session id of "." or ".." leaves the titles directory. roleStateFile escapes the same way but appends .json, which is what saves it. No exploit path — the id is Claude Code's own UUID — so hardening: give the title file a suffix as the role file has, or refuse an id that encodes to "." or "..".
